youtube.title: The Navy Ship That Supposedly Vanished | The Philadelphia Experiment
youtube.description:
The legend says that in 1943 the USS Eldridge vanished from the Philadelphia Navy Yard in a green glow and reappeared in Norfolk. The story really begins in 1956, with letters from Carl Allen ("Carlos Allende") to UFO author Morris Jessup. In 1957 two Office of Naval Research officers had a contractor, Varo, reprint about 127 annotated copies of Jessup's book, which made the tale look official. The Navy says the Eldridge's records show no such experiment. The real wartime technology was degaussing, which reduced a ship's magnetic signature against mines.

📂 Case File #022: The Philadelphia Experiment

Sources: Military.com, "This Is the Truth Behind WWII's Creepy Philadelphia Experiment"; Indian Defence Review, on the Eldridge's Navy records; Naval History and Heritage Command.
Images: US Navy (public domain, Wikimedia Commons).
Narration voice: AI.
